News about Wrath. . .

There have been changes.

No one is Squirrels.

Still no cake.

 

To give you an idea of where I rank the different expansions and this one with them:

Rook City:  Spicy Carnitas Tacos.

Infernal Relics:  Fancy Seafood Tacos.

Shattered Timelines:  Steak Tacos.

Vengeance:  Ground Beef Tacos.

Wrath of the Cosmos:  Chicken Tacos.

It took me a while to come up with those rankings, but I think it best portrays my thoughts on the expansions.
